frozen_before: any micro-cap after-hours bar or quote was fetched; no event list or return exists for this universe
purpose: Decide whether the core AH->PM micro-cap strategy has any positive subset when entries pay the quoted NBBO ask and exits receive the quoted bid. If none passes, propose to Juan that the AH->PM strategy be stopped or replaced.
origin: five liquid-universe tests failed (October 9-14); the 89 real AH entries model at -0.76% per trade at the 04:30 open (docs/investigations/init3-exec-gap-2026-10-09.md). The core universe has never had a frozen historical census.
window: events dated 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (full 16:00 closes only); AH volume history from 2025-08-25
universe: symbols in log/2026-10-12/init7-reversal20-pit/universe.json.gz (Alpaca active and inactive assets plus S&P 500 members since 2016), excluding the point-in-time top 1000 by trailing three-month SIP dollar volume for D's month (rankings() of scripts/init7-liquid-ah-census.py on log/2026-10-13/init7-liquid-ah-census/monthly.json.gz), with a raw regular-session close on D between $0.50 and $10.00. Market cap and float are not available point in time and are not filtered.
data: Alpaca SIP: daily raw and split-adjusted bars for the whole universe; 5-minute raw bars 16:00-16:59 ET on each full day for symbols passing the price and rank filters that day; latest SIP quote in a window per event.

event.price_1630: close of the last 5-minute bar starting at or before 16:25 ET is >= +10% above D's regular close
event.price_1700: close of the last 5-minute bar starting at or before 16:55 ET is >= +10% above D's regular close (the two checkpoints mirror the live two-AH-scan gate)
event.total_ceiling: price_1700 <= +150% above D's regular close (live entry extension ceiling)
event.day_change: D's regular close > -15% versus D-1's close (live dead-cat filter)
event.volume: 16:00-16:55 ET shares >= 100,000 AND dollars >= $100,000 AND shares >= 3x the median of the same window over the symbol's prior 20 fetched sessions (sessions without bars count as zero); at least 20 prior fetched sessions required
event.split: drop events whose raw/split-adjusted close ratio changes by >1% from D to D+1; count drops

entry: ask of the latest SIP quote at or before 17:00:00 ET with timestamp >= 16:45:00 ET (23:00 CEST, the first live entry scan); requires bid > 0 and ask > bid. Events without such a quote are excluded as unexecutable and counted.

exits.exit_0430: bid of the latest SIP quote in 04:00-04:30 ET on D+1 (the live sell-all rule since October 14); if none is valid, D+1 official open x (1 - 50 bps), counted as fallback
exits.exit_open: D+1 official raw open x (1 - 50 bps)

unit: net return per trade = exit / entry - 1; equal weight per event

subsets.build: price_1700 >= price_1630 (still building at the entry scan)
subsets.fresh: not a multi-session runner: none of D-2, D-1, D closed >= +50% above its own prior close AND D's close < 2x the close of D-3 (live tag definition)

statistics.interval: bootstrap resampling event dates (D) with replacement, 4000 draws, seed 13; two-sided interval with tail 0.025/8 (Bonferroni over 8 cells)
statistics.pass: a cell passes if mean > 0 AND interval lower bound > 0 AND both chronological halves (split by D at the median event date) have mean > 0, at base cost; also report +100 bps round-trip stress, gross mid-to-mid returns, median and win rate

descriptive_only: price_1700 buckets (10-25%, 25-50%, 50-150%), close price buckets, AH dollar-volume buckets, entry spread quartiles, events per month, excluded counts, and recall of the 89 real entries (log/2026-10-09/init3-exec-gap/result.json rows) as events. None can rescue a failed pass.
decision_if_pass: do not promote: retest the passing cell unchanged on 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30. Only a pass there too leads to a narrowed live entry rule, applied under the standing directive and reported for Juan's veto.
decision_if_fail: propose to Juan through the daily email that the AH->PM micro-cap strategy be stopped or replaced; no live rule changes from this census alone.
limits: entry at 17:00 ET only (live entries also occur 17:30-18:30 ET); no catalyst grading; survivorship limited to the assets Alpaca still lists; no borrow, fee or partial-fill model; quoted size ignored.
